meta.description: Brookline movers for apartments, condos and family homes, sent from our Brighton base. Hourly billing with wrap and truck costs included. Free quote.

overview: Most Brookline moves we're asked to quote are apartments and condos, often with stairs and a tight spot to park the truck. Our crews come from our head office in Brighton, the Boston neighborhood that borders Brookline.
Before you book, a manager walks you through the hourly billing, so you know what drives the total.
sellingPoints: Crews from our Brighton base next door
Stairwells and elevator windows planned ahead
Wrap, tape and truck costs counted in the rate

servicesBlock.h2: Moving Help We Bring to Brookline
servicesBlock.intro: We plan Brookline moves for renters on the September 1 cycle and for young families moving into more space. Every service below is available here, and most people combine two or three of them on one quote.

whyChoose.h2: What Brookline Customers Get From Better Life Moving

cards.title: Head Office Over the Line in Brighton
cards.text: We're based at 20 Presentation Rd in Brighton, which borders Brookline. Your move is run by the Boston office, not a call center somewhere else.

cards.title: Ready for the Lease Turnover
cards.text: Late August and September are our busiest weeks. Brookline renters moving on September 1 should lock in a date as early as they can.

cards.title: Third Floors Are Routine
cards.text: Narrow stairwells and long carries are everyday work for our crews. Reviewers often bring up tough staircases handled with care.

cards.title: Your Movers Work for Us
cards.text: Better Life Moving is a carrier. The crew carrying your sofa is ours, under USDOT 3866930, MC 1414489.

faq.q: How much do Brookline movers from Better Life Moving cost?
faq.a: Local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added, and a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time. In a Brookline apartment, the stairs and the walk from the truck to your door decide most of the hours.

faq.q: Can your crew handle a Brookline walk-up with no elevator?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us the floor and the stairwell when you book, and the crew plans which pieces come down first and how.

faq.q: Who arranges parking for the moving truck in Brookline?
faq.a: You know your street best, so check what the town requires for a moving truck and tell us what you've set up. The crew parks where you've reserved space.

faq.q: Can you store my things between two Brookline leases?
faq.a: Yes. We pick up, hold your belongings and deliver on the date the new place opens. Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up.

faq.q: Do you move people from Brookline to other states?
faq.a: Yes. Out-of-state moves from Brookline are long distance moves, quoted at a flat rate and driven on our own trucks.

faqClosing: Have another question before your Brookline move? The FAQ page covers billing, booking and the moving day itself.

closing.body: Tell us the floor, the date and where you're headed. A manager explains how the hours add up before the crew is scheduled.
